# docker_container_top (Data Source)

Lists the processes running in a container, like `docker container top`. `top.titles` holds the column names and `top.processes` one row per process; the container must be running.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_container_top" "web" {
  container = "web"
  ps_args   = "aux"
}

output "web_processes" {
  value = data.docker_container_top.web.top.processes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) The container to read, by ID or name.

### Optional

- `ps_args` (String) Arguments for `ps` on the host (Engine `ps_args`), e.g. `aux`. Default `-ef`.

### Read-Only

- `container_id` (String) ID of the container the processes were read from.
- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of top_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `top` (Attributes) The GET /containers/{id}/top response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--top))
- `top_json` (String) The Engine API GET /containers/{id}/top response as JSON; process rows in the order ps printed them. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).

<a id="nestedatt--top"></a>
### Nested Schema for `top`

Read-Only:

- `processes` (List of List of String) Upstream `Processes`.
- `titles` (List of String) Upstream `Titles`.
